Report_ID: Caries prevalence (dmfs > 0) in primary teeth at 36 months
Title: Randomized Trial of Motivational Interviewing to Prevent Early Childhood Caries in American Indian Children
Author: Batliner TS, Tiwari T, Henderson WG, Wilson AR, Gregorich SE, et al.
Comment: Per-arm event counts could NOT be extracted verbatim: the Results text reports only a combined range ("55% to 56% at 3 y") across both groups and the Appendix Table containing the exact per-arm prevalence figures is not reproduced in the available full text, so it is not stated which arm had 55% and which had 56%. Events therefore left empty rather than invented (55% of 232 ≈ 128 and 56% of 238 ≈ 133 would be a guess as to arm assignment). Totals are the numbers of dyads assessed at 36 mo from Table 3 (232 MI + ECS, 238 ECS). P = 0.67 is from a mixed-effects binomial model for the group × time interaction in prevalence; no RR or OR is reported by the paper.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Motivational interviewing + enhanced community services (MI + ECS)') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False); unsupported or insufficient statistic type
domain: dental public health / early childhood caries prevention

Title: Efficacy of an oral health promotion intervention in the prevention of early childhood caries
Author: Plutzer K, Spencer AJ
Comment: Caries definition is restricted to labial surfaces of the maxillary incisors only (trial's own S-ECC definition); no whole-mouth any-primary-tooth caries outcome is reported.
